data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'duran', meaning 'peacock'. This name signifies beauty, grace, and the pursuit of noble goals. The name Droon carries the meaning “Peacock” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Droon usually hope their child will grow to embody peacock and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Droon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Peacock.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Droon total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: دروان
in_arabic.meaning: دروان تعني الشخص الذي يملك القلب السليم والنية الطيبة
in_arabic.long_meaning: دروان هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'د-ر-و' والذي يرتبط بمعاني الصحة والسلامة. في اللغة العربية، يعني دروان الشخص الذي يملك القلب السليم والنية الطيبة، ويتميز بالتوازن والاستقامة في أفعاله وأقواله. وقد وردت هذه المعاني في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن الصالحين والمتقين.

in_urdu.name: دروان
